lines: Give the sun to a frozen heart.
And I am that position for you.
I was nursing a rather arrogant assumption.
I’m sorry.
Just laugh.
A positivity so intense it could burn.
I realized its coldness and cruelty.
What I want to give you is something both cool and hot.
It’s not a pretty lie, but it’s beautiful and unwavering.
It warms the deepest part of the chest, beyond the surface.
I have ideals, yet wherever I search in my heart…
…they never appear.
I want to convey, but it doesn’t reach.
That absurdity now
binds me tightly.
My cowardly self
in every move I make
Words are like snowflakes.
Even if I wanted to give them to you
the more I become obsessed,
the shape crumbles, falls and melts away.
and disappears.
But the words I choose
carry the yearning placed there
I can’t give up on making your heart tremble.
More than saying I love you, until love reaches you
just wait a little longer.
Even standing beside you in thin clothes
I end up sweating unnecessarily.
No matter what, my lukewarm self will only hurt you.
“Isn’t the heart cold when the palm feels hot?”
Don’t say such cruel things even as a joke.
You could just say it.
Even if I wager my whole life, please overturn it properly.
To save is to be saved.
This equation now
gently peels away.
A rigidly armed theory
and an over‑packaged pride
I want kindness more than correctness.
And the one who can receive it
should be like an illumination,
not a crowd, but just one person.
I want that person to be you.
Trying to mend the cracked fissure with the words I spoke
the curtain was pulled back by the excess heat I added
Such a failure
I want to keep stacking it, stacking it, stacking it
until I someday find it
the perfect line, word for word.
Words are like snowflakes.
Even if I present them to you
when time passes, most of them
spill from memory, melt away.
and disappear, but
they constantly become like subtitles attached to our story
when we look back
or glance unexpectedly
I want to keep searching for what makes your heart tremble.
More than saying I love you, until love reaches you
just wait a little longer.
To the point where I don’t even want any words.
Even on a night frozen by sorrow
I am by your side on my own accord
thinking about this and that
Even after the snow melts, it remains.
Even after the snow melts, it remains.
